transkript.t: This open source model from Google lets you predict anything in the future.
This is Times FM, Google's new AI model for time series forecasting,
trained on 100 billion real world data points. Think stock prices, your sleep score each night,
or even your business and sales forecast. Until now, you'd have to train a separate
model with your own data every single time, which takes weeks and costs a heck ton of money.
But Times FM flips this completely. You just give it your historical numbers,
and it forecasts the future with zero training required, because it already learned patterns
from billions of real data points across sales, traffic, energy, and more. And the new version
doesn't just tell you what will happen, it also tells you how confident it is. So instead of a
single number, you get a full range from best case to worst case and everything in between.
It's already live inside Google Sheets and BigQuery, which means your finance team can
forecast next quarter without waiting a single line of code.
